evidence: Labeled 'Validation' and modifies reindex chainstate activation and header verification in src/validation.cpp and src/node/blockstorage.cpp.
rationale: Restores assumevalid script verification skipping during reindex after an interrupted IBD. When reindexing starts from an interrupted sync with headers below minimumchainwork, the node currently falls back to full script verification for all blocks; deferring activation to sync headers speeds up this salvage scenario, though it addresses a narrow edge case.
